title: Dogecoin ETFs lose their bite as Bitcoin, Ethereum big dogs lead the pack
summary: The total value traded for spot DOGE ETFs reached its lowest point since launch, signaling a fading of the early hype as liquidity and flows lag well behind those of major crypto ETFs.

title: Bitcoin's ‘bear flag pattern’ targets $67K as BTC spot demand slumps
summary: The absence of new buyers and weakening ETF demand are factors likely to keep the Bitcoin price pinned below $93,000 as a bear flag targets $67,000.

title: ‘Elite’ traders hunt dopamine-seeking retail on prediction markets: 10x Research
summary: Rising retail participation incentivizes data-driven, “elite” traders to use “information asymmetry” and spreads caused by casual investors seeking a quick buck, 10x said.

title: Polygon deploys Madhugiri hard fork, aims for 33% throughput boost
summary: Polygon’s hard fork cuts consensus time to one second, supports Fusaka EIPs and lays the groundwork for stablecoin and RWA-focused scaling.

title: HashKey crypto exchange opens Hong Kong IPO subscription, targets $215M
summary: HashKey opens IPO subscriptions as it seeks to raise $214.7 million, valuing Hong Kong’s biggest crypto exchange at about $2.5 billion.

title: Will Zcash's ZEC return to $500 or higher before 2026?
summary: Bullish reversal signals and rising whale demand increase ZEC’s chances of hitting $500 in December, though some caution remains warranted.

title: Circle gets Abu Dhabi greenlight amid UAE stablecoin and crypto push
summary: Circle has secured a license in Abu Dhabi, enabling it to operate as a licensed Money Services Provider as the UAE accelerates its rollout of crypto regulations.

title: NFT winter deepens: Monthly sales hit lowest point of the year
summary: NFT sales fell to $320 million in November — their lowest this year — with early December off to a weak start as top collections slide across the board.

title: Bitcoin retail inflows to Binance ‘collapse’ to 400 BTC record low in 2025
summary: Bitcoin retail investors have been sending fewer BTC to Binance per day than at any time in history, despite the new highs of the 2025 bull market.

title: Crypto index funds ‘a big deal’ as market complexity grows: Bitwise CIO
summary: Wide crypto-tracking funds will become more popular as investors will seek exposure as the market becomes more complex, says Bitwise’s Matt Hougan.
